newsitem.title: UK: Brent Apr/May spread leaps as buyer moves in.
newsitem.headline: Brent Apr/May spread leaps as buyer moves in.

text.p: Aggressive buying by a Wall Street trader widened the North Sea Brent April/May spread sharply, paper traders said.
April/May traded several times at a high of +22 cents, having fetched just +6 cents earlier.
"(The trading house) just moved in and bought everything it could in half an hour. Looks like it's expecting a strong April market," said one dealer.
The buying spree left the May-related CFD market unsettled, with buyers and sellers both reluctant to show numbers.
"Obviously (CFDs) have come right up but no-one wants to stick their neck out," a trader said.
When April/May was languishing near lows, CFDs for next week were assessed around May Brent -37/32, while March 24-27 traded at May-30 cents.
Outright April Brent bounced off support after dipping on the release of bearish U.S. stocks data, and futures were trading 32 cents up at $19.56 a barrel at 1635 GMT.
Remaining wet March Brent barrels still looked under pressure, however, with one seller showing a second decade cargo five cents lower than this morning at April Brent -45 cents.
Buying interest was seen at April -50 cents.
Bucking the trend in the physical market was Ekofisk , which traded at a firmer Dated Brent +14 cents for a March 25-27 loader.
April Forties was assessed as low as Dated Brent +10 cents, and the next Oseberg trade could be at a discount to Dated Brent, traders said.
